def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    item_count = bins // item
    leftover_space = bins % item
    priority_scores = item_count / (1 + leftover_space)
    return np.where(valid_mask, priority_scores, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    prio[valid_mask] = item - bins[valid_mask]
    return prio

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    priorities[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return priorities
